items.title: EFG Hermes ONE and Bank NXT Launch Egypt’s First Bank-Brokerage Credit Card
items.why: Bank-brokerage linked cards in emerging markets are a model to watch, though not a direct US opportunity.
items.summary_ai: EFG Hermes ONE and Bank NXT launched a credit card in Egypt linked to a brokerage account, described as the country's first.
items.take: Bank-brokerage linked cards in emerging markets are a model to watch, though not a direct US opportunity.
